nodes.label:
New Laptop
Arrives
nodes.title: New Laptop Arrives
nodes.info: A laptop as it arrives from a vendor, before any club-specific setup has been applied.

nodes.label:
Laptop
Configuration
nodes.title: Laptop Configuration
nodes.info: The shared setup every club machine gets regardless of platform: accounts, network, the tools the curriculum needs, and the restrictions the club's policy requires.

nodes.label:
Which
Platform?
nodes.title: Which Platform?
nodes.info: The laptop's operating system determines which management path and console it will use for the rest of its service life.

nodes.label:
Chromebook
Management
nodes.title: Chromebook Management
nodes.info: Managed through the Google Admin console: enrolment ties the device to the club's domain, and policy is pushed centrally. The lowest-effort path, which is why so many clubs standardise on it.

nodes.label:
Windows Device
Management
nodes.title: Windows Device Management
nodes.info: Managed through Windows tooling such as Intune or local group policy. More configurable than a Chromebook and correspondingly more work to keep consistent across a fleet.

nodes.label:
macOS Device
Management
nodes.title: macOS Device Management
nodes.info: Managed through Apple Business Manager and an MDM profile. Common in clubs that inherited donated Macs rather than choosing them.

nodes.label:
Ready for
Student Login
nodes.title: Ready for Student Login
nodes.info: Once platform-specific management is in place, the laptop is ready to receive the student account setup covered next in this chapter.
